blocks.text: The 29th French Film Festival drew a full house at SM City Manila for its opening, marking the return of one of the country’s much-awaited celebrations of French cinema. Leading the opening were French Ambassador H.E. Donatienne Hissard and SM Supermalls EVP for Marketing Joaquin San Agustin, joined by FDCP Executive Director Rachelle Villaluna and SM Supermalls Senior Assistant Vice President for Operations John Brian Tarnate. This year’s festival features 24 acclaimed films spanning history, feminism, animation and literature, including fresh adaptations of Les Misérables and Le Fantôme de l’Opéra, historical films on Charles de Gaulle, and compelling stories celebrating women’s […]...
